name: Decision 2.0: Open Foundation Decision Models
description: One pass. Many decisions. Six Decision 2.0 models.

paragraphs: Ask many Choice, Noul and Score questions about one input and read every probability. Decision 2.0 models answer all questions about the same input together in one forward pass; Explore the original generation in the Decision 1.0 model collection. Route a prompt before calling an LLM, compare a batch of contexts with shared questions, or ask several related questions about one case, with nine LLM-routing scenarios plus model-specific English scenarios.

The deployed service also includes a server-authoritative Tetris Race playground. It compares any two configured Decision 2.0 models. Both runners receive the same seeded piece sequence but keep independent boards, requests, actions, timing, and traces.
